quote: Paul Biran posed the generalization to arbitrary surfaces in his 1999 paper 'A stability property of symplectic packing' published in Inventiones mathematicae, Volume 136, pages 123–155
note: The original Nagata conjecture on curves was posed by Masayoshi Nagata in 1959. The Nagata–Biran conjecture is Biran's 1999 generalization to arbitrary polarized algebraic surfaces, expressed in terms of Seshadri constants.
